# SQL Identity Resolution (`sql-identity-oss`)

> Headless, warehouse-native deterministic & fuzzy identity resolution for DuckDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks. Zero data movement. 100% SQL-auditable.

## Docs Index
- Home & Overview: https://anilkulkarni87.github.io/sql-identity-oss/

- Algorithm & Graph Engine: https://anilkulkarni87.github.io/sql-identity-oss/algorithm-and-graph-engine/
- Configuration & Governance: https://anilkulkarni87.github.io/sql-identity-oss/configuration-and-governance/

- Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`): https://github.com/anilkulkarni87/sql-identity-oss/blob/main/skills/sql-identity-resolution/SKILL.md

## Headless Interfaces
- **CLI**: `idr init`, `idr doctor`, `idr bootstrap`, `idr apply-config`, `idr run --mode FULL|INCR`, `idr evaluate`, `idr privacy forget`
- **Python SDK**: `from idr_core.runner import IDRRunner, RunConfig`
- **dbt Package**: `dbt_idr`
- **MCP Server**: `idr-mcp` (`stdio`) or FastAPI `POST /mcp` (`streamable-http`)
- **Webhooks**: set `IDR_WEBHOOK_URL` (+ optional `IDR_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) for `run.completed`, `run.failed`, `guardrail.skipped_groups_spike`, `crosswalk.cluster_changes`, `privacy.erasure_completed`

## Config Modeling Workflow for Agents
1. `get_system_status()` (MCP) or `idr doctor` (CLI)
2. `discover_and_suggest_rules(schema=...)` (MCP) or `idr bootstrap --schema ... --output idr_config.yaml` (CLI)
3. `simulate_rule_impact(...)` (MCP) to check supernode risk
4. `dry_run_pipeline()` (MCP) or `idr run --dry-run` (CLI)
5. `idr apply-config` + `idr run --mode FULL`

## Minimal Config Structure (YAML/JSON)
```yaml
sources:
  - id: customers
    table: db.schema.customers
    entity_type: PERSON
    entity_key: customer_id
    watermark: updated_at
    identifiers:
      - type: email
        expr: email
    attributes:
      - name: first_name
        expr: first_name
use_default_exclusions: true
rules:
  - id: "104"
    type: EXACT
    match_keys: [email]
    priority: 1
    canonicalize: EMAIL_STANDARD
survivorship:
  - attribute: first_name
    strategy: RECENCY
    source_priority: [customers]
```

## Production Benchmarks (6.3M Entities, 15 Source Tables)
- **Snowflake**: 170s (2.8 min, ~37k entities/sec)
- **Databricks SQL Warehouse**: 296s (4.9 min, ~21k entities/sec)
- **Google BigQuery**: 306s (5.1 min, ~21k entities/sec)
